content.text: The digital product economy is structurally unfair to creators in restricted markets. The tools that Western creators take for granted — [[LINK:https://coremerch.github.io/store/blog/stripe-alternatives-nigerian-creators-which-[[LINK:https://coremerch.github.io/store/blog/real-[[LINK:https://coremerch.github.io/store/blog/real-architecture-behind-selling-design-assets-crypto-payments-15|COREMERCH guide to architecture]]-behind-selling-music-online-accepting-bitcoin-20|The Real]]-actually-works-13|stripe]] for payments, Gumroad for storefront and delivery, PayPal for international transfers — are either unavailable or functionally broken for creators in Nigeria, Ghana, Kenya, Pakistan, Bangladesh, Zimbabwe, and dozens of other markets. The answer is not finding a better platform. The answer is removing the platform layer entirely. A sovereign digital commerce stack gives you a storefront you host, a payment processor that runs on blockchain rails, and an automated delivery system that sends your product within 30 seconds of payment confirmation. You collect revenue directly into a wallet you control. You convert to local currency through P2P exchanges at near-market rates. The platform cannot suspend you because you are not on any platform.

This post is part of the COREMERCH infrastructure series. For the complete foundation — every component, every configuration step, and the full deployment sequence — read the pillar guide: How to Start Selling Digital Products with Crypto Payments at https://coremerch.github.io/store/blog/understanding-automated-digital-product-delivery-crypto-plain-language-15. That guide covers the complete architecture that this post builds on.

content.text: What This Actually Is and Why It Matters: Cloudflare digital

The Cloudflare R2 storage solution is a game-changer for digital creators who need a sovereign and reliable way to store and deliver their products. By leveraging Cloudflare's network, creators can ensure that their products are delivered quickly and securely, without relying on intermediaries like Gumroad or Payhip. This approach matters because it allows creators to maintain ownership and control over their digital products, while also reducing their dependence on platforms that charge exorbitant fees.
How the Architecture Works Under the Hood

The architecture behind Cloudflare R2 for digital product storage and delivery is built on a combination of free and paid tools. By using GitHub Pages or Cloudflare Pages for hosting, Cloudflare Workers or Google Apps Script for backend logic, and Supabase or Google Sheets for order storage, creators can build a fully operational online store with automatic crypto payment processing and instant product delivery. This approach eliminates the need for intermediaries and allows creators to maintain full data ownership.
Who This Is Built For and Why

This solution is built for digital creators who are tired of being locked out of conventional payment platforms or who want to maintain ownership and control over their digital products. By using Cloudflare R2 and a combination of free and paid tools, creators can build a sovereign digital commerce stack that is tailored to their specific needs. This approach is particularly useful for creators who sell digital products like ebooks, courses, templates, fonts, and software, and who need a reliable way to store and deliver their products without relying on intermediaries.
Cloudflare R2 is a game-changer for digital creators who need a sovereign and reliable way to store and deliver their products.
The Components That Make It Work Together

The components that make this solution work together include Cloudflare R2 for storage, GitHub Pages or Cloudflare Pages for hosting, Cloudflare Workers or Google Apps Script for backend logic, and Supabase or Google Sheets for order storage. By integrating these components, creators can build a fully operational online store that is secure, reliable, and scalable. Additionally, by using NOWPayments for automatic crypto payment verification, creators can accept payments in over 300 cryptocurrencies, with a fee of only 0.5% per transaction.
How to Use This Knowledge to Deploy Today

To deploy this solution today, creators can start by setting up a Cloudflare R2 storage account and integrating it with their GitHub Pages or Cloudflare Pages hosting. They can then use Cloudflare Workers or Google Apps Script to build backend logic and Supabase or Google Sheets to store orders. By following these steps, creators can build a sovereign digital commerce stack that is tailored to their specific needs and allows them to maintain ownership and control over their digital products.
How do I sell an ebook online without PayPal or Stripe?

To sell an ebook online without PayPal or Stripe, creators can use a combination of Cloudflare R2 for storage, GitHub Pages or Cloudflare Pages for hosting, and NOWPayments for automatic crypto payment verification. This approach allows creators to maintain ownership and control over their digital products, while also reducing their dependence on intermediaries that charge exorbitant fees. For example, Gumroad charges 10% on every sale, while NOWPayments charges only 0.5%, which can result in significant savings for creators who sell digital products regularly.
NOWPayments charges only 0.5% per transaction, compared to Gumroad's 10% fee.

By visiting the Coremerch shop at https://coremerch.github.io/products.html, creators can learn more about this solution and how it can help them maintain ownership and control over their digital products.
Your Deployment Checklist

To deploy a sovereign digital commerce stack, creators can follow these steps: set up a Cloudflare R2 storage account, integrate it with GitHub Pages or Cloudflare Pages hosting, use Cloudflare Workers or Google Apps Script to build backend logic, store orders in Supabase or Google Sheets, and use NOWPayments for automatic crypto payment verification. By following these steps, creators can build a fully operational online store that is secure, reliable, and scalable, and allows them to maintain ownership and control over their digital products.
